title: How Tesla & SpaceX pay for their chips
thesis: Two of Elon Musk's companies spend at the very top of the chip market — yet follow the dollars and they fan out, then pool back onto a handful of fabs and memory makers. The gold is money; trace where it actually ends up.

cards.title: Nvidia & AMD GPUs
cards.body: Tesla's single biggest external chip line. Its Cortex cluster runs *~50,000* Nvidia H100s plus Tesla's own hardware; a 10k-GPU pod alone runs *$300M+*. 2024 capex topped *$11B*, largely AI compute, with AMD's Instinct as a second source.

cards.title: AI5, AI6 & Dojo
cards.body: Tesla designs the chip, then pays a foundry to build it. *TSMC* makes AI5 (Taiwan to Arizona); *Samsung* makes today's AI4 and won AI6 in a *$16.5B* deal (Taylor, TX, through 2033). Dojo's custom team wound down in 2025, folding into AI5/AI6.

cards.title: Memory: SK Hynix, Samsung, Micron
cards.body: Tesla buys *SK Hynix* memory and *Samsung LPDDR5X* for AI5, plus DRAM/NAND for vehicles. The same three also supply the *HBM* inside every Nvidia/AMD GPU, so Tesla pays them twice over, directly and embedded.

cards.title: Power, analog, MCU & sensors
cards.body: The unglamorous bulk of a car: *Infineon*, *STMicro* (SiC inverter), *NXP* (radar, networking), *Texas Instruments* (power/analog), *onsemi* (cameras, SiC), *Analog Devices* (battery mgmt) and *Renesas* (MCUs).

cards.title: STMicro RF + custom silicon
cards.body: *STMicroelectronics* co-designs Starlink's phased-array front-end: over *5B* RF chips shipped in a decade, ~*$600M* of LEO revenue in 2025. As an IDM it builds them in its own fabs, so this money largely stops there. SpaceX is also designing its own RF modules.

cards.title: TSMC + the memory three
cards.body: Nvidia and AMD are fabless, so your GPU dollars flow on to *TSMC* (logic) and *SK Hynix / Samsung / Micron* (HBM). Add Tesla's own-chip contracts and the convergence is stark: a handful of names catch most of the money, with *TSMC* the deepest well.

source: CNN / Bloomberg / Reuters on the Samsung–Tesla $16.5B foundry deal · Tom's Hardware / TrendForce / DigiTimes on AI5/AI6 nodes & memory · DataCenterDynamics on Tesla AI capex · STMicro newsroom / SemiWiki on Starlink RF (paraphrased, through mid-2026)
